item.title: Incarico post-doc: ncarico Post-Doc - GEOS-01/C - Effects of saltwater intrusion on mercury mobility in coastal contaminated soils (Univ. TRIESTE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 23:59
Institution: Univ. TRIESTE, Trieste
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-01 Mineralogia, petrologia, geochimica, vulcanologia, georisorse e applicazioni

The candidate will investigate the effects of salinity variations on mercury mobility in coastal groundwater. Specifically, the research activities will involve groundwater monitoring with recording of physico-chemical parameters and the execution of related compositional and speciation analyses on groundwater and soil, along with the investigation of the biogeochemical processes regulating mercury mobility under different salinity conditions, in support of the definition of environmental management strategies. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Post-doc assignment (Univ. GENOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. GENOVA, Genova
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-01 Mineralogia, petrologia, geochimica, vulcanologia, georisorse e applicazioni

The project will develop an integrated archaeometric approach to the study of pigments and ceramics, focusing specifically on cobalt-based pigments. By experimenting with the thermal transformation of natural minerals, the project will establish correlations between raw materials, preparation processes, firing conditions, and the final products found in ceramic bodies, coatings, and decorations. Mineralogical, microstructural, and chemical analyses will enable the reconstruction of recipes, technologies, and potential provenances. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Incarico Post-Doc - GEOS-04/A - Development and Optimization of Algorithms for Real-Time Seismic Monitoring and Ground-Shaking Map Generation (Univ. TRIESTE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. TRIESTE, Trieste
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-04 Geofisica

research activities in real-time and near-real-time seismic monitoring, ranging from data acquisition to the automatic processing of accelerometric data at regional and national scale. The candidate will be involved in the development and optimization of algorithms for the automatic computation of ground-shaking and seismic source parameters, for the generation of shaking maps, and for the characterization of seismic background noise. This also includes the development of data-driven and probabilistic methods (e.g., neural networks, Bayesian models) for reconstructing shaking fields from sparse data, within the broader framework of applying seismological techniques to applied geophysics…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 post-doc research contract - Department of Biological, Geological, and Environmental Sciences (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-26 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-03 Geografia fisica, geomorfologia e geologia applicata

Title of the project: "Modelling of compound fluvial and marine coastal flooding, climate change impacts on agricultural systems and risk assessment". Modelling of compound coastal flooding from river discharge and marine processes (extreme events and sea-level rise) for flood risk assessment and adaptation of agricultural systems, including crops, grasslands and livestock. Development of hazard and impact indicators to evaluate the effects on agricultural productivity and crop suitability under different climate change scenarios. Analysis and integration of remote sensing data and information.
